Bcl2a1a is a well‑known NF‑κB‑responsive pro‑survival gene; loss of Paf1 impairs Pol II elongation and reduces NF‑κB‑driven transcription, leading to lower Bcl2a1a mRNA levels. No direct DNA‑binding evidence exists, but the indirect scaffold‑activator role predicts down‑regulation.
